title: Studio Quality Rule: Relief on Change Order Fees After Studio Errors — Design Studio Selections
content:
On a Design Studio Selections file, the studio-error relief percent of a fee-bearing change order is set by the error-correcting change orders recorded on the file:

| Error-correcting change orders recorded on the file | Studio-error relief percent |
|---|---|
| Two or more | 20 percent |
| Exactly one | 10 percent |
| None | No relief |

**Records read.** The change order entries on the design ledger written to correct a studio or builder error.

*Hypothetical cases:* a file with one error-correcting change order has a relief percent of 10; a file with three has 20; a file with none has no relief.
